MAJOR_DEFECT_FOUND_AND_FIXED_CI_RED_FOR_.what: The 'CI' workflow has been FAILING on every one of the last 11 pushes (579f9c4 through 806ea13) on exactly one step: 'Every JS test file runs in exactly one place'.
MAJOR_DEFECT_FOUND_AND_FIXED_CI_RED_FOR_.root_cause: mine. In cycle 89 (commit 579f9c4) I added tests/test_gf_pageview.js. It passes locally but I never registered it in .github/workflows/ci.yml, so CI never ran it. The guard correctly refuses to let a tracked test sit outside every batch.
MAJOR_DEFECT_FOUND_AND_FIXED_CI_RED_FOR_.fix: scheduled tests/test_gf_pageview.js in the batch that already runs the other customer-site tests (test_check_jsonl_duplication, test_customer_auth, test_customer_front_door)
MAJOR_DEFECT_FOUND_AND_FIXED_CI_RED_FOR_.verification: replayed the guard locally exactly as CI executes it: now prints 'every JS test file runs in exactly one place' and exits 0; the newly scheduled file runs green via scripts/run_js_group.js
MAJOR_DEFECT_FOUND_AND_FIXED_CI_RED_FOR_.is_this_the_only_cause: YES - across all 11 red runs the ONLY failing step is this one. No other cause.

MY_OWN_REPORTING_ERROR_DISCLOSED.what: Each push produces TWO workflows: 'pages build and deployment' and 'CI'. I had been verifying and reporting the PAGES workflow as if it were CI.
MY_OWN_REPORTING_ERROR_DISCLOSED.consequence: Pages has been 20/20 green all along, so I reported '3/3 success' for 11 consecutive commits while the real CI workflow was red every time. The red was caused by my own cycle-89 omission.
MY_OWN_REPORTING_ERROR_DISCLOSED.correction: CI status must be read from the workflow named 'CI'. Reported from now on as both workflows explicitly.
